entities.summary:
Bo Ya (b. unknown, d. 1000 BCE) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Classical era, active in Global. Known for his contributions to composers & musicians, Bo Ya played a significant role in shaping the artistic landscape of ancient civilizations.






Bo Ya's work had a lasting impact on the development of music and art in ancient Global, influencing generations of artists and musicians to come.






His legacy extends beyond his own time, with his artistic and musical contributions continuing to inspire and influence contemporary artists and musicians.
